B5.2_kiba_cold_start.description: Run cold-drug, cold-target, cold-both splits on KIBA dataset

computational_cost.estimated_gpu_hours: 150-200 hours (3 splits × 5 seeds × 2 architectures × ~4-5 hours per run)

data_requirements.cold_drug_test_size: Unknown - need to compute Bemis-Murcko scaffolds for KIBA drugs
data_requirements.cold_target_test_size: Unknown - need to define cold-target split for 229 KIBA targets
data_requirements.cold_both_test_size: Unknown - intersection of cold-drug and cold-target

technical_challenges: KIBA dataset is 4x larger than Davis (118K vs 30K pairs)
Training instability observed in Davis may be worse on KIBA
No existing split definitions for KIBA cold-start
Need to implement cold-start split logic for KIBA
Statistical power concerns (n=5 seeds may be insufficient)

pros: Directly addresses reviewer concern about generalization
Provides KIBA counterpart to Davis cold-start analysis
cons: KIBA already shows anomalous baseline (MSE=0.522 vs published 0.147)
Cold-start results may be confounded by baseline instability
Limited by same statistical power issues as Davis (n=5)

B5.2_kiba_cold_start.recommendation: NOT RECOMMENDED - High computational cost, limited scientific value given KIBA baseline anomaly. Better to acknowledge limitation and suggest as future work.

B5.3_kiba_scaffold_split.description: Run Bemis-Murcko scaffold split on KIBA dataset

computational_cost.estimated_gpu_hours: 50-70 hours (1 split × 5 seeds × 2 architectures × ~5-7 hours per run)

data_requirements.scaffold_split_definition: Need to compute Bemis-Murcko scaffolds for 2111 KIBA drugs

technical_challenges: KIBA has 2111 drugs vs Davis 68 drugs - more scaffolds to compute
Need to ensure sufficient drugs per scaffold for 70/10/20 split
RDKit scaffold computation for 2111 drugs is feasible but time-consuming
Risk of imbalanced split (some scaffolds may have very few drugs)

pros: Addresses reviewer concern about scaffold generalization
Provides KIBA counterpart to Davis scaffold analysis
Tests if Davis scaffold degradation (-38.22%) is dataset-specific
cons: KIBA baseline anomaly may confound results
Limited by same statistical power issues (n=5)
Davis scaffold result was not significant (p=0.075)

B5.3_kiba_scaffold_split.recommendation: NOT RECOMMENDED - Moderate computational cost but limited scientific value given KIBA baseline anomaly and non-significant Davis result. Better to acknowledge limitation.

overall_assessment.conclusion: Neither B5.2 nor B5.3 is recommended
reasons: KIBA baseline is 3.6x worse than published GraphDTA-GIN (MSE 0.522 vs 0.147)
Any cold-start/scaffold results on KIBA would be confounded by this anomaly
High computational cost (200-270 GPU hours total)
Limited scientific value given existing Davis results
overall_assessment.alternative_approach: Add to Limitations section: 'Cold-start and scaffold split evaluations were performed only on Davis due to computational constraints and KIBA baseline instability. Future work should extend these analyses to KIBA with improved training protocols.'
